definition: to speak angrily with someone you disagree with
description: A young woman with long dark hair in a striped pastel cardigan stands face to face with a young man in a grey T-shirt in a bright living room. With one arm crossed, she points her finger at him and talks at him with a stern face while he answers back. Then he looks up at the ceiling with his mouth open, trying to think of something to say, and she watches him with a small, satisfied smile. Behind them are a beige corner sofa with cushions, a wooden coffee table and white curtains.
transcript: It was your fault. No, it was your fault. So name an example. I knew it, it was your fault.
